note: Hand-written part of the Customer AI Briefing: agents, decisions and AI-credit contract terms per customer. Everything else (customer, contracts, AI units, offers, tickets, invoices, renewals) is pulled from the Sub4Me and Renewals data by npm run sync:customer-briefing.

agents.name: Invoice Matching Agent
agents.desc: Matches supplier invoices with purchase orders and goods receipts in S/4HANA Finance and posts the clean ones.
agents.human: A person decides on every mismatch above 5,000 EUR.
agents.next: Add the three-way match for service entry sheets (Q1 2027).

agents.name: Accrual Proposal Agent
agents.desc: Proposes month-end accruals from open purchase orders and goods receipts.
agents.human: A controller approves every accrual.
agents.next: Extend to payroll accruals.

agents.name: Bank Reconciliation Agent
agents.desc: Reconciles the bank statements with open items and clears the clear matches.
agents.human: Planned: exceptions go to the accounts team.
agents.next: Pilot with the Hamburg and Lyon accounts in November, go-live 7 December.

agents.name: Close Orchestrator
agents.desc: Coordinates the close tasks between the other finance agents and the people.
agents.human: The controller releases each close step.
agents.next: Kick-off in January 2027; needs the AI-unit top-up first.

agents.name: Dunning and Collections Agent
agents.desc: Writes and sends reminders for overdue invoices and tracks the answers.
agents.human: Not decided yet.
agents.next: Business case with the next budget round.

agents.name: Supplier Risk Agent
agents.desc: Screens suppliers for financial, sanction and delivery risk and flags changes.
agents.human: Buyers decide on every red supplier.
agents.next: Ariba AI budget is at 82 %: top-up with the renewal.

agents.name: Purchase Order Confirmation Agent
agents.desc: Reads supplier order confirmations, compares dates and prices with the order and updates S/4HANA.
agents.human: Deviations above 3 % go to the buyer.
agents.next: Add the confirmations that arrive by e-mail attachment.

agents.name: Delivery Delay Agent
agents.desc: Spots late shipments, proposes a new date and drafts the message to the customer.
agents.human: Planners send every message.
agents.next: Connect the carrier feed for the Lyon plant.

agents.name: Goods Receipt Matching Agent
agents.desc: Matches delivery notes with goods receipts and flags differences.
agents.human: Differences above 1 % go to the warehouse lead.
agents.next: Pilot in the Mannheim warehouse.

agents.name: Inventory Rebalancing Agent
agents.desc: Proposes stock transfers between plants to avoid shortages and excess stock.
agents.human: A planner approves each transfer above 20,000 EUR.
agents.next: Calibrate with last year's demand.

agents.name: Demand Sensing Agent
agents.desc: Refreshes short-term demand forecasts from orders, stock and market signals.
agents.human: Planners release forecast changes above 10 %.
agents.next: Kick-off after the Inventory Rebalancing go-live.

agents.name: Supplier Onboarding Agent
agents.desc: Checks supplier documents and fills the master data request.
agents.human: Purchasing approves each new supplier.
agents.next: Open topic for the next budget round.

agents.name: Transport Planning Copilot
agents.desc: Suggests routes and carriers for outbound shipments.
agents.human: Dispatchers confirm each plan.
agents.next: Depends on the carrier feed.

decisions.t: Re-size the AI-unit volume for the full roll-out
decisions.w: With all 13 suite agents live the suite alone needs about twice the contracted 120,000 units a year; the 2026 volume is used up in December already.

decisions.t: Decide the SuccessFactors Employee Central renewal
decisions.w: The decision date was 2 October; renew together with the AI-unit re-sizing.

decisions.t: Approve the Bank Reconciliation go-live on 7 December
decisions.w: It adds about 1,200 AI units a month on BTP AI Core, which is already at 94 % of its budget.

contractModels.label: Pay as you go
contractModels.what: Every unit is billed after use at the list price. No commitment, no discount, no cap.
contractModels.fit: Flexible, but the most expensive per unit and hard to plan.

contractModels.label: Agreed consumption per year
contractModels.what: The customer commits to a yearly volume at a discounted unit price; units beyond the volume are billed as overage.
contractModels.fit: Planning security for both sides; overage needs a rule.
contractModels.terms: 120,000 units for 2026 at the agreed price of 3.00 EUR per unit (360,000 EUR a year). Overage above 120,000 units is billed at the list price of 4.20 EUR per unit.

contractModels.label: Fixed consumption per year
contractModels.what: A fixed yearly volume with a hard cap: when it is used up, agents are throttled or stopped until the next period or a top-up.
contractModels.fit: Cost is capped, but business processes can stop.

contractModels.label: Rollover
contractModels.what: Unused units move to the next period (usually capped and valid for 12 months).
contractModels.fit: Protects the customer against under-use in the ramp-up year.

contractModels.label: Prepaid credit pool
contractModels.what: One prepaid pool is drawn down by all products (Joule, AI Core, Document AI, Ariba AI).
contractModels.fit: Simple to steer across products; one number to watch.

contractModels.label: Top-up packs
contractModels.what: Extra units can be bought in fixed packs during the year at the agreed unit price, without a new contract.
contractModels.fit: Quick remedy when a product runs out early.
contractModels.terms: Packs of 10,000 units at 3.00 EUR per unit, ordered by the customer admin, effective the next day.

agents.name: Invoice Matching Agent

agents.human: A person decides on every mismatch above 3,000 EUR and on every invoice from a GxP-critical supplier.
agents.next: Add the three-way match for service entry sheets of the laboratory services.

agents.name: Accrual Proposal Agent
agents.desc: Proposes month-end accruals from open purchase orders and unbilled clinical-supply deliveries.
agents.human: A controller approves every accrual.
agents.next: Pilot in the October close, go-live 1 December.

agents.name: Intercompany Reconciliation Agent
agents.desc: Reconciles intercompany balances between Heidelberg, Penzberg and Basel and proposes the clearing postings.
agents.human: A controller approves every posting across the Swiss entity.
agents.next: Agree the transfer-pricing rules with Tax before the pilot.

agents.name: Cash Application Agent
agents.desc: Matches incoming payments and bank statements with open items.
agents.human: A person decides on every payment that cannot be matched with high confidence.
agents.next: Business case after the first full quarter of the Invoice Matching Agent.

agents.name: Month-End Close Orchestrator
agents.desc: Coordinates the finance agents and the manual steps of the month-end close and reports the status.
agents.human: The close manager owns the checklist and signs off every close.
agents.next: Starts when three finance agents are live.

agents.name: Batch Record Review Agent
agents.desc: Reads the scanned batch records, checks completeness and signatures and flags entries that need a second look.
agents.human: Quality Assurance releases every batch; the agent only prepares the review. Productive use needs the approved validation concept.
agents.next: Validation concept in review; handwritten corrections are the open point (ticket TKT-48097).

agents.name: Deviation Triage Agent
agents.desc: Classifies incoming deviations, finds similar earlier cases and proposes the investigation owner.
agents.human: A quality manager classifies every deviation; the agent only suggests.
agents.next: Pilot with deviations of the Penzberg plant.

agents.name: Goods Receipt Matching Agent
agents.desc: Matches delivery notes and certificates of analysis with goods receipts in S/4HANA.
agents.human: A person decides on every delivery without a valid certificate of analysis.
agents.next: Add the cold-chain temperature logger data to the match.

agents.name: Supplier Qualification Agent
agents.desc: Checks supplier documents and audit reports against the qualification checklist for GxP suppliers.
agents.human: Quality Assurance decides on every supplier status.
agents.next: Depends on the Ariba renewal (offer OFF-2026-0510).

agents.name: Cold-Chain Excursion Agent
agents.desc: Assesses temperature excursions in shipments, proposes keep, quarantine or scrap and notifies the logistics team.
agents.human: A quality manager decides on every quarantine or scrap proposal.
agents.next: Include the stability data of the products to cut the false alarms.

agents.name: Demand Sensing Agent
agents.desc: Adjusts the short-term demand forecast in Integrated Business Planning with tender and order signals.
agents.human: The planner confirms every change above 15 % of a product forecast.
agents.next: Add the tender calendar of the public health insurers.

agents.name: Serialization Exception Agent
agents.desc: Analyses rejected serial number messages from the repositories and proposes the correction.
agents.human: A packaging supervisor approves every correction before it is sent.
agents.next: Wait for the fix of the Swiss schema error (ticket TKT-48188).

agents.name: Supply Orchestrator
agents.desc: Coordinates the supply agents and escalates conflicts between demand, batches and cold-chain capacity.
agents.human: The supply chain lead owns every escalation.
agents.next: Starts when four supply agents are live.
